title: Comparison pullback of the canonical Cartier class
statement: For n>0, finite A killed by n and effective Cartier i:D→Z with n invertible on Z, define geoCartierCanonicalClass in the ordinary pro-etale Ext group [def-sfb-geo-cartier-interface] by exact comparison inverse image of the unique ordinary boundary class [def-sfb-geo-cartier-canonical-etale], precomposed with the inverse supported mate [lem-sfb-geo-cartier-source-comparison]. It satisfies the forward comparison equation with that ordinary boundary class.

source.place: Paragraph 1: apply exact comparison inverse image to the constructed class

proof.text: Apply exact comparison inverse image to the unique ordinary class and precompose with the inverse supported-source mate. Associativity of Ext composition and the two inverse identities prove the forward comparison equation. The construction uses no arbitrary choice of an isomorphism.

def geoCartierCanonicalClass (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A]
    (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) (hA : (n : A) = 0) {D Z : Scheme.{u}}
    (i : D ⟶ Z) [IsClosedImmersion i] (hI : i.ker.IsInvertible)
    (hZ : IsUnit (n : Γ(Z, ⊤))) : GeoCartierClass A n hA i
